evidence.detail: No existing champion/belt tracking code found anywhere in the codebase; feature is entirely unimplemented
Current match insertion has no hook for belt-transfer logic; would require new DB table, trigger on match result, and handling of 'champion goes inactive' edge case

triage.notes: Requires at minimum: a new DB table for belt history, logic to transfer the belt on each sanctioned match loss, a definition of 'first sanctioned PD match', and policy for what happens when the champion stops playing. Scope is well beyond 150 lines and likely needs a schema migration.
